Recent Calls and call statistics

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

The list is divided into sections such as Today, Yesterday and This Week. The filter button chooses All, Missed, Outgoing or Incoming; Search searches the list.

Tapping an entry (double-tapping with a screen reader) calls the number back. If Tap to Call is off, it opens the details.

The actions menu has Call Back, Send message, Details, Add to Contacts, Add to favorites, Block number, Delete Call Log, Copy and Share.

Details opens full screen and shows your whole call history with that number and the total talk time.

The Options menu at the top has Call statistics, Clear List, Group by Type, Group by Person and No Grouping.

On the Call statistics screen, choose Week, Month or Year; you can move to the previous or next period. The Summary section shows total calls and talk time, followed by Incoming calls and Outgoing calls.

The lists Most talked with, Most called by you and Called you most are here too. With Copy report and Share report you can pass the summary on.
